page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.re8.90xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 360 dedicated vCPUs utilizing Intel Xeon 8490H processors running at a baseline clock speed of 1.9 GHz. The instance is equipped with 6144.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high resource density of approximately 17.07 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 96 Gbps. There are zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with the instance.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.re8.90xlarge represents a high-density hardware profile designed for massive memory-bound workloads. The lack of local NVMe storage and dedicated GPUs represents a clear tradeoff, focusing the resource allocation entirely on memory capacity and CPU cores. This configuration is designed for large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, massive data caching layers, and heavy memory-intensive enterprise applications.
